test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 12 Mar 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Name the Indian state that has four international airports.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kerala**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Kerala is the only Indian state with four international airports: Trivandrum International Airport, Cochin International Airport, Calicut International Airport, and Kannur International Airport.
 
• These airports serve as major hubs for international travel and cargo, boosting Kerala's connectivity with the rest of the world.
 
• Cochin International Airport is notable for being the world's first fully solar-powered airport.
 
• The presence of multiple international airports supports Kerala’s significant non-resident Indian (NRI) community, who frequently travel to and from the Gulf countries and other regions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Trivandrum International Airport:**

 
 
• Located in Thiruvananthapuram, the capital city of Kerala.
 
• It is one of the oldest airports in India, established in 1932.
 
• The airport serves as a gateway to the southern region of Kerala and parts of Tamil Nadu.
 
 
 
• **Cochin International Airport:**
 
 
• Located in Kochi, it is one of the busiest airports in India.
 
• It holds the distinction of being the world's first fully solar-powered airport.
 
• The airport has won several awards for its sustainable practices and infrastructure.
 
 
 
• **Calicut International Airport:**
 
 
• Located in Karipur, near Kozhikode, it primarily serves the northern part of Kerala.
 
• The airport plays a crucial role in connecting the region to the Middle East.
 
• It is also known for its close proximity to the city of Malappuram.
 
 
 
• **Kannur International Airport:**
 
 
• Located in Mattannur, near Kannur, this is the newest addition to Kerala's international airports.
 
• It was inaugurated in December 2018 and significantly improves air connectivity in the northern region of Kerala.
 
• The airport has been designed to handle both international and domestic flights efficiently.
